physical_protocol.claim_scope: Cross-fitted Development diagnostic only; this is not a unified physical benchmark. Predicted-latent physical error is interpretable only after the held-out true-latent readout floor is shown to be sufficiently small.
limitations: The readout is fitted separately for each frozen checkpoint and task; raw latent errors remain encoder-specific.

Zero across-condition physical variance is reported with a null normalized metric rather than hidden by an epsilon.

protocol.scope: Existing nine-task Development panels; Speed unseen interpolation only; all 136 checkpoint/task runs and all 2436 sources; no Test and no world-model training
protocol.history_control: Cross-score free predictions produced under every real condition history against every real condition future, retaining shared present image, past commands and future actions. Uniform mean over other histories. No future-observation refresh.
protocol.history_caveat: Delay control jointly changes evidence about delay and its hidden pending-action state; visible-state equality is not equality of all Markov variables.
protocol.physical_validation: Fixed source-group three-fold cross-fitted auxiliary ridge readout. Fit only other source groups' true-future features and selected simulator coordinates; never fit to held-out query labels or predicted features. Report held-out true-feature readout error alongside predicted-feature error. Diagnostic calibration uses Development labels; not a zero-shot common physical benchmark.

physical_coordinates.pusht: pusher xy, block xy, 40 sin(theta), 40 cos(theta) (px equivalent)

protocol.feature_rule: LeWM/PLDM native vector; DINO-WM fixed 4x4 spatial means of patch features, applied identically to true and predicted latents. Readout pooling never changes native primary score.
protocol.interpretation: History gain without low matched error is not accurate ICL. Physical readout results require small held-out true-feature decoding error and do not prove off-manifold decoding validity. No automated capability pass/fail gate.
protocol.statistics: All matching training repetitions equally averaged; source-group paired bootstrap shared across repetitions; never treat conditions/candidates/horizons as independent samples
protocol.documentation: One existing primary score. Validation tables and limitations separate, no extra overall average, no silent replacement of frozen historical numbers. Explain facts before hypotheses.

readout_configuration.high_dimension_projection: fixed sparse random projection to 512 dimensions when features exceed 512; no selection based on outcomes
readout_configuration.training: auxiliary calibration only; no world-model weights or optimizer updated

inference_batching.receipt_field: inference_batch_size; absent in the initial receipt schema means 8
inference_batching.numerical_control: Every query is checked against the previous batch-8 full-prediction result; weights and precision remain fixed.

protocol.physical_visibility: Report camera-support limits separately. Positions outside the rendered canvas can be unidentifiable from a target image; no query is filtered and no primary score is changed.
